agent_notes: Government-directory identity is verified in both supplied NIRF 2025 sources; the exact row names Motilal Nehru National Institute of Technology and city Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh.
Normal TLS returned the managed proxy self-signed certificate-chain error; curl --insecure was used only for public GETs to the confirmed NIRF and MNNIT official hosts.
The official website is established as https://mnnit.ac.in/ and its official academic subdomain is https://academics.mnnit.ac.in/.

Catalogue status is partial/manual review because the current AY 2026 pages confirm programme families, while the central PG page is marked valid for 2020-21, the About Us summary conflicts with the current B.Tech list, the current M.Tech specialization list is AY 2025-26, and the Ph.D. catalogue is category-level rather than department-level.

The official About Us page, updated 23 February 2026, lists Master of Social work (M.S.W.), but the current 2026 fresh-registration page does not list it; it was retained as an official catalogue-discovered programme and flagged for review.

No active diploma or certificate programme was identified in the official academic/admissions catalogue. Short-term-course and conference links were excluded as events rather than degree, diploma or certificate programmes.
